content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has published the recruitment notice for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) under Special Advertisement No. 52/2026.

The online application window is listed from 22/08/2026 to 11/09/2026. The application deadline is tomorrow, so candidates should complete the form before the closing time and verify all details on the preview page before submission.

Application checklist

  • Complete registration on the official UPSC online application portal.
  • Keep a recent photograph, signature, identity proof and educational documents ready.
  • Pay the applicable fee and verify every field on the preview screen.
  • Save the registration number, payment receipt and final submitted application.

The written examination is currently listed for 20/12/2026. Admit card and further selection updates should be checked on the official UPSC website.
